description: This file provides utility functions for cryptographic operations related to generating and decoding organization IDs based on a tenant salt and email addresses. It uses the CryptoJS library for AES encryption/decryption, focusing on a specific method of transforming emails into secure identifiers.

methods.name: hexToWordArray(hex)
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string into a CryptoJS WordArray, used for key derivation.

methods.name: generateOrganizationId(email)
methods.description: Generates a unique organization ID by encrypting a normalized email with AES-128-ECB using a tenant-specific salt, then encodes the ciphertext in URL-encoded base64 without padding.

methods.name: decryptOrganizationId(encUrlEncoded)
methods.description: Decrypts an encoded organization ID back into the original email for debugging purposes, reversing the encryption process.

methods.name: isTenantSaltValid()
methods.description: Checks if the tenant salt value is set and non-empty, indicating if it is valid for cryptographic operations.
